summary: ExlService Holdings filed an 8-K reporting the appointment of Bhupender Singh as President and Head of International Growth Markets, effective May 11, 2026. Mr. Singh previously served as President and Co-CEO at Teleperformance SE. The filing details his compensation: annual base salary of £447,761, discretionary bonus target of 90% of base salary, and an initial equity grant of restricted stock units valued at £1,791,044 vesting pro rata over four years. While this is an executive hire, it appears to be a routine appointment rather than a forced or abrupt departure of a prior officer, so the event does not clearly qualify as a special-situation management change. The filing indicates no board recommendation or advisor. There is no structural or transactional event to watch.
